changelog: v1.0 — one license, one shared notebook. Every device you activate with your license is the same notebook and they keep each other up to date on their own: products, shelves, and now your team too, with their PINs and roles. Clear hierarchy: Owner, Admin, Staff. Works offline, your data stays yours, no subscriptions, no ads. Now you can add and manage your associates (the people who sell for you) right from Commissions.
